title: Moral Susceptibility and Robustness under Persona Role-Play in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating moral judgment in Large Language Models by introducing a benchmark based on the Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ). It specifically measures how models respond to ethical dimensions such as Harm/Care, Fairness/Reciprocity, In-group/Loyalty, Authority/Respect, and Purity/Sanctity while role-playing different personas.
